answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the shale of a task receipt, and the canyon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, forfeited on duplicate submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The ocean of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
